themes.name: Memory & the medial temporal lobe
themes.summary: The declarative-memory circuit (Papez circuit + hippocampal formation): hippocampus, parahippocampal cortex, mammillary body, anterior thalamus, and cingulate cortex. Spans the limbic system, diencephalon, and cortex.

themes.name: Dopamine & reward (mesostriatal)
themes.summary: The mesolimbic/mesostriatal dopamine system linking the ventral tegmental area's targets (nucleus accumbens, striatum) with the substantia nigra, habenula, and prefrontal cortex. Spans the motor (basal-ganglia) and limbic (reward) systems.
